items.title: Buckingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2019
items.q: And Sid Sharp looks at me and said, “Who’s doing the arrangements?” I said, “Gene Page.”

ctx.x: So finally it was like five ‘til. And Sid Sharp looks at me and said, “Who’s doing the arrangements?” I said, “Gene Page.” And he rolled his eyes.
Oh he gave the look, oh.
